entries.name: Screen
entries.summary: Text-mode drawing on the base layer: text, boxes, fills, block moves, lines, shades, progress bars, and pixel helpers for mode 10.
entries.description: Text-mode drawing on the base layer: text, boxes, fills, block moves, lines, shades, progress bars, and pixel helpers for mode 10. Region calls take inclusive corners (x1, y1, x2, y2). Constants: Screen.COLS (40), Screen.ROWS (30), Screen.SINGLE, Screen.DOUBLE, Screen.INVERT (0x80). The Attributes namespace (part of this framework) names the colours and the inverse bit for attr arguments.

entries.name: Attributes
entries.summary: Attribute values by name for the attr argument of every Screen and Overlay call: colours plus Attributes.Inverse.
entries.description: An attribute byte is a colour index (bits 0-2) plus the inverse bit (0x80). Attributes.Red .. Attributes.Orange are the mode-1 default palette entries 1-8 (Screen.Palette recolours them); Attributes.Inverse swaps text and background, so a space with Attributes.Blue + Attributes.Inverse is a solid blue block. Add a colour and Inverse together; never add two colours. Defined by the Screen framework, used by Overlay calls too.
entries.example: Screen.Fill(2, 3, 37, 3, 32, Attributes.Red + Attributes.Inverse)  -- a red bar

entries.name: Overlay
entries.summary: The same drawing calls on the overlay layer, composited over the base: dialogs, menus, HUDs.
entries.description: The same drawing calls on the overlay layer, composited over the base: dialogs, menus, HUDs. Cells you write show, untouched cells stay transparent, Overlay.Clear() hides everything. Constants as Screen.

entries.summary: String helpers for a 40-column screen: alignment and padding, truncation, word wrap, splitting and joining, zero-padding and thousands separators..
entries.description: String helpers for a 40-column screen: alignment and padding, truncation, word wrap, splitting and joining, zero-padding and thousands separators.

entries.description: Timer objects with an id: one-shots (After) and repeats (Every) that can be cancelled, paused, resumed and restarted. Methods on the object (t:Pause()) and functions (Timer.Pause(t) or Timer.Pause(t.id)) are the same. Built on the OS's 8 timers per program.

entries.name: Sound.Define
entries.summary: Defines an instrument 0..29 (30 and 31 are used by Tone and Noise): spec = {wave="square"|"pulse"|"triangle"|"saw"|"sine"|"noise", duty=1..15, attack=ms, decay=ms, sustain=0..255, release=ms, volume=0..255}.
entries.description: Defines an instrument 0..29 (30 and 31 are used by Tone and Noise): spec = {wave="square"|"pulse"|"triangle"|"saw"|"sine"|"noise", duty=1..15, attack=ms, decay=ms, sustain=0..255, release=ms, volume=0..255}.
entries.example: Sound.Define(1, { wave = "triangle", attack = 5, decay = 50, sustain = 150, release = 80 })

entries.name: Sound.Load
entries.summary: Loads a WAV file from the card into the sample pool; returns a sound id usable with Sound.Play and in scores.
entries.description: Loads a WAV file from the card into the sample pool; returns a sound id usable with Sound.Play and in scores.

entries.name: Sound.Play
entries.summary: Plays an instrument or sample: `note` is a MIDI number or a name such as "C4"; `ms` 0 means the instrument's own envelope; pan -64..63.
entries.description: Plays an instrument or sample: `note` is a MIDI number or a name such as "C4"; `ms` 0 means the instrument's own envelope; pan -64..63.

entries.name: Sound.Stop
entries.summary: Stops one voice returned by a Play call, or every one-shot voice.
entries.description: Stops one voice returned by a Play call, or every one-shot voice.

entries.name: Sound.Volume
entries.summary: Sets the master volume 0..255.
entries.description: Sets the master volume 0..255.

entries.name: Music.Define
entries.summary: Defines a score by name (see lua.md for the spec: channels of {time, sound, note, length, volume, pan} events, `loop`, `length`).
entries.description: Defines a score by name (see lua.md for the spec: channels of {time, sound, note, length, volume, pan} events, `loop`, `length`).

entries.name: Music.Play
entries.summary: Starts a defined score; `loop` overrides the score's own loop flag.
entries.description: Starts a defined score; `loop` overrides the score's own loop flag.

entries.name: Music.Stop
entries.summary: Stops the score that is playing.
entries.description: Stops the score that is playing.

entries.name: Music.Playing
entries.summary: True while a score is playing.
entries.description: True while a score is playing.
entries.example: if not Music.Playing() then Music.Play("theme") end

entries.name: Text.Center
entries.summary: `s` centred in `width` cells, padded with `fill` (default space); longer strings are returned unchanged.
entries.description: `s` centred in `width` cells, padded with `fill` (default space); longer strings are returned unchanged.

entries.name: Text.Left
entries.summary: `s` padded on the right to `width` cells (left-aligned).
entries.description: `s` padded on the right to `width` cells (left-aligned).

entries.name: Text.Right
entries.summary: `s` padded on the left to `width` cells (right-aligned).
entries.description: `s` padded on the left to `width` cells (right-aligned).

entries.name: Text.Truncate
entries.summary: `s` cut to `width` cells, ending in `ellipsis` (default "..") when it had to be cut.
entries.description: `s` cut to `width` cells, ending in `ellipsis` (default "..") when it had to be cut.

entries.name: Text.Wrap
entries.summary: Word-wraps `s` to lines of at most `width` cells; words longer than the width are split.
entries.description: Word-wraps `s` to lines of at most `width` cells; words longer than the width are split. Newlines in `s` start new lines. Returns an array of lines.
entries.example: for i, line in ipairs(Text.Wrap(story, 36)) do Screen.OutText(2, 4 + i, line) end

entries.name: Text.Lines
entries.summary: Splits `s` on newlines into an array of lines.
entries.description: Splits `s` on newlines into an array of lines.

entries.name: Text.Split
entries.summary: Splits `s` on `sep` (a plain string, default: runs of whitespace).
entries.description: Splits `s` on `sep` (a plain string, default: runs of whitespace).

entries.name: Text.Join
entries.summary: Joins an array of values into one string with `sep` (default " ").
entries.description: Joins an array of values into one string with `sep` (default " ").

entries.name: Text.Trim
entries.summary: `s` without leading and trailing whitespace.
entries.description: `s` without leading and trailing whitespace.

entries.name: Text.StartsWith
entries.summary: True when `s` begins with `prefix`.
entries.description: True when `s` begins with `prefix`.

entries.name: Text.EndsWith
entries.summary: True when `s` ends with `suffix`.
entries.description: True when `s` ends with `suffix`.

entries.name: Text.Zero
entries.summary: Integer `n` zero-padded to `width` digits: Text.Zero(7, 3) is "007".
entries.description: Integer `n` zero-padded to `width` digits: Text.Zero(7, 3) is "007".

entries.name: Text.Commas
entries.summary: Integer `n` with thousands separators: Text.Commas(1234567) is "1,234,567".
entries.description: Integer `n` with thousands separators: Text.Commas(1234567) is "1,234,567".

entries.name: Text.Plural
entries.summary: "1 file" / "3 files": the count and the right word.
entries.description: "1 file" / "3 files": the count and the right word.

entries.name: Timer.Create
entries.summary: A timer calling fn(timer) every `ms` milliseconds, or once when `oneshot` is true.
entries.description: A timer calling fn(timer) every `ms` milliseconds, or once when `oneshot` is true. Returns the timer object (its `id` field is the number Timer.Get and the other calls accept). Raises an error when the program's 8 OS timers are all in use.

entries.name: Timer.After
entries.summary: Calls fn(timer) once, `ms` milliseconds from now.
entries.description: Calls fn(timer) once, `ms` milliseconds from now. Returns the timer.

entries.name: Timer.Every
entries.summary: Calls fn(timer) every `ms` milliseconds until cancelled.
entries.description: Calls fn(timer) every `ms` milliseconds until cancelled. Returns the timer.
entries.example: local blink = Timer.Every(500, function() cursor_on = not cursor_on end)

entries.name: Timer.Cancel
entries.summary: Stops a timer for good (object or id).
entries.description: Stops a timer for good (object or id). Returns true if it was live.

entries.name: Timer.Pause
entries.summary: Stops the clock on a running timer, remembering how long was left until its next fire.
entries.description: Stops the clock on a running timer, remembering how long was left until its next fire. Returns true if it was running.
entries.example: spawner:Pause()   -- while the pause menu is open

entries.name: Timer.Resume
entries.summary: Restarts a paused timer with the time that was left when it was paused.
entries.description: Restarts a paused timer with the time that was left when it was paused. Returns true if it was paused.
entries.example: spawner:Resume()  -- continues with the time that was left

entries.name: Timer.Restart
entries.summary: Re-arms a timer from now with its interval (or a new one), whether it was running, paused or already fired.
entries.description: Re-arms a timer from now with its interval (or a new one), whether it was running, paused or already fired. Returns the timer.

entries.name: Timer.Running
entries.summary: True while the timer is armed (not paused, cancelled or fired).
entries.description: True while the timer is armed (not paused, cancelled or fired).

entries.name: Timer.Paused
entries.summary: True while the timer is paused.
entries.description: True while the timer is paused.

entries.name: Timer.Remaining
entries.summary: Milliseconds until the next fire (frozen while paused), or nil when the timer is done.
entries.description: Milliseconds until the next fire (frozen while paused), or nil when the timer is done.

entries.name: Timer.Get
entries.summary: The live timer object with that id, or nil.
entries.description: The live timer object with that id, or nil.

entries.name: Timer.CancelAll
entries.summary: Cancels every live timer this framework created.
entries.description: Cancels every live timer this framework created. Returns how many.

entries.name: Timer.Count
entries.summary: How many timers are live (running or paused).
entries.description: How many timers are live (running or paused).
